first_divergence_from_lockstep_gold: Stall at 21.9s sim time (CameraSourceError on segmentation bridge causing lockstep halt)
evidence_based_root_cause: Gazebo image bridge timeout on segmentation port likely blocked Gazebo, halting lockstep. ArduPilot blocked waiting for sensor data and ceased MAVLink broadcasts.
recommended_smallest_fix: Fix Gazebo segmentation image bridge connection/timeout issue, or relax stall timeout if segmentation bridge naturally blocks during heavy initialisation.
